facts.did: 已有二十个征程没乘渡船去中转大厅，这是自遇见 Murtis 以来分别最久的一次，与 Oriel 融合也无法减轻痛苦
facts.anchor: the longest they had gone without seeing Murtis

facts.did: 实验室在 Spiralstair 接手后陷入混乱，他们花了几个征程说服这位飘忽的新导师把自己送回 Tentacle，否则无法完成论文、参加第四次考试
facts.anchor: the lab had been in chaos after Spiralstair took over

facts.did: 在 Tentacle 港口下船，收拢关于 Memory 的心绪；看到 Milk Road 酒馆的星墙重新明亮，火山灰已被冲走
facts.anchor: starry walls of the Milk Road taberna were bright again

facts.did: 告诉 Peristyle 病的是 Julia 而不是 Murtis：Julia 病了，Murtis 应付不来，不是在床边守着就是献祭、从埃及找治疗师
facts.anchor: It’s Julia. She’s sick, and Murtis can’t handle it.

facts.did: 告诉 Peristyle 已把一切告诉 Julia（两人的关系、她的来处、她能治愈与给予快感），Julia 接受；并请求 Peristyle 救 Julia
facts.anchor: I told Julia everything. I told her about us

facts.did: 用触手进入 Julia 体内逐细胞检查，清理真菌与动物，并逐个刺破 Julia 喉部与肺部肿瘤里的突变细胞
facts.anchor: clusters of cells forming tumors in Julia’s throat

facts.did: 把体内一切排清：排出细胞团、细菌与真菌，与健康的排泄物、生物膜混在恶臭的团块里
facts.anchor: She expelled cellular masses, bacteria, and fungi

facts.did: 在浴场同时连通 Julia 与 Murtis，把另一根触手伸进 Murtis 体内——她此前从未同时进入两个 Unnamed
facts.anchor: Peristyle had never gone inside two Unnamed before

relations.relation: 牵挂：担心 Murtis 是否死于本可预防的疾病、是否已把全部爱给了 Julia
relations.anchor: Had they given all their love to Julia?

relations.relation: 老友：Peristyle 伸双臂拥抱柜台后的 Curly，发现他身体更轻更脆、一只眼因病变暗
relations.anchor: reached out both arms to hug the man behind the counter

relations.relation: 恋人：Murtis 称她 My love、说非常想念她并需要她帮助
relations.anchor: My love. I have missed you so much.

relations.relation: 恋人/伴侣：两人在浴场互相拥抱、把嘴唇贴上彼此的脸，并同时散发出情欲的气味
relations.anchor: the two women pressed lips to each other’s faces

relations.relation: 治疗者与病人：Peristyle 小心翼翼地伸触手进入 Julia 体内检查（视之为维护而非屠杀）
relations.anchor: sent a tentacle inside, feeling her way gingerly

numbers.fact: 在 Murtis 与 Julia 的时间尺度里，二十个征程等于五年
numbers.anchor: For Murtis and Julia, twenty journeys was five years

numbers.fact: 对 Murtis 与 Julia 而言二十个征程即五年，是其生命中显著的跨度
numbers.anchor: twenty journeys was five years, and that was a significant

numbers.fact: Julia 花三天把体内的一切清理干净
numbers.anchor: took three days for Julia to clear everything

numbers.fact: 到病中的第四天早晨，Julia 已能吃下一整餐并加以代谢
numbers.anchor: By the fourth morning of her ordeal, Julia was able to eat
